snippet.title: Assault Bandit
snippet.description:
Now available for iOS Universal.  https://itunes.apple.com/app/id518444321
Fed up with flicking? Raggedy from running? Jaded about jumping? Sick of sucking?  Get awesome in Assault Bandit!

Hop into your hotrod and blast up the streets. Fast moving upgrade system keeps you challenged so you can push the limits of speed and unleash some wicked firepower!
